schemes.name: comp18_low_plate_over_the_whole_plot
schemes.secondary_language: one storey of office spread over the entire plot, its roof the public ground
schemes.formal_principle: 필지 전체를 덮는 한 켜의 판이 지붕을 공공 마당으로 내준다.
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; the 60% coverage limit and 5-storey cap are the supplied parcel constraints

ops.why: the 1/4 vertical opening is the whole plot at a quarter of the height budget - a plate, not a block, and this word stands it up
three light shafts through a deep plate; without them the middle of a plot-wide floor has no daylight, and the delivered depth to any court is the limitation
the entrance court is cut from the open side so the plate is entered rather than walked around

schemes.name: comp18_three_eighths_l_holds_the_corner
schemes.secondary_language: an L of three quarters of the plan at half the height, wrapping the street corner
schemes.formal_principle: 평면의 4분면 중 셋만 쓰는 L자가 모서리를 잡고 남은 한 칸을 마당으로 비운다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: an L holding a corner void
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; the BOOK records 3/8 as three connected octants

ops.why: 3/8 is the BOOK connected three-octant L; this grammar receives it as its bounding box, so the missing quadrant is cut back in below
the missing fourth quadrant, cut rather than left out - the limitation is that it is a cut and not the octant figure itself
the section is a base shape, not an assembly: one ridge along the long wing gives the L a front rather than a flat lid

schemes.name: comp18_oval_drum_and_its_mirror
schemes.secondary_language: a half-height oval drum and its mirror image standing clear across a slot
schemes.formal_principle: 타원 드럼 하나와 그 거울상이 틈을 사이에 두고 마주 선다.
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; a reflection is a 4x4 with determinant -1, so the twin is congruent rather than a copy at another size

ops.why: no matrix turns a square into a circle - the plan family is chosen at the opening, and 1/2 vertical gives a drum of half the height budget
the mirror stands beside what it doubles; handedness reverses and volume is preserved exactly, which is the whole content of the word
the two drums are one building: a bridge crosses the slot at mid-height and stops at its neighbour

schemes.name: comp18_four_packed_rooms_in_one_frame
schemes.secondary_language: four equal halls set inside one plot-wide frame without touching
schemes.formal_principle: 하나의 테두리 안에 네 개의 방이 서로 닿지 않게 놓인다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: four rooms and the gaps between them
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; packing is an arrangement, and what makes it legible is that the pieces do not touch

ops.why: the container the packing is measured in - half the height budget over the whole plot
four pieces on a grid, the container given over to what it holds; the gaps between them are the streets of the plan and the limitation is that the grid is deterministic rather than searched
the row is pushed out of alignment so the four read as a settlement rather than as a waffle

schemes.name: comp18_raked_flank_against_the_north
schemes.secondary_language: a full-height bar whose north flank is cut back by one oblique plane
schemes.formal_principle: 북쪽 옆면을 비스듬한 평면 하나로 깎아 이웃의 하늘을 돌려준다.
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; the supplied sunlight envelope leaves 100% of this plot to 9 m and 87% at 19 m

ops.why: half the plot depth at the full height budget - a bar that can afford to lose a flank
one oblique half-space differenced from the body, removing half of tan(angle) times height squared times depth. It draws the sunlight envelope as a decision instead of suffering it as a clip
the entrance is cut on the standing flank so the raked side stays one plane

schemes.name: comp18_split_pair_slid_apart
schemes.secondary_language: one bar cut in two and the halves slid apart, the taller half taking what the lower gives up
schemes.formal_principle: 하나의 바를 둘로 갈라 벌리되, 낮아진 쪽이 내놓은 것을 높은 쪽이 가져간다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: two halves and the gap between them
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; Requicha 1980 - a plane cuts a solid into two half-space intersections whose union is the solid

ops.why: half the plot length at the full budget
the gap is a displacement and not a deletion: the halves keep their material and step apart, and 6 m between them is a room-wide lane rather than a construction joint
the lower half is raked where it faces the lane, so the slot widens as it rises

schemes.name: comp18_arrayed_wings_on_one_spine
schemes.secondary_language: one wing repeated three times along a spine, each instance clear of the last
schemes.formal_principle: 하나의 날개가 등뼈를 따라 세 번 되풀이되고 사이마다 마당이 열린다.
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; an array is one transform applied n times, so the family reads as one decision rather than n placements

ops.why: an eighth of the plot length at the full budget - one wing, deliberately small, because the repetition is the subject
the same wing at an accumulated step; the courts between them are what the array makes, and the limitation is that the instances are equal by construction
a low spine at ground level ties the three wings into one building without closing the courts above it

schemes.name: comp18_vaulted_hall_over_a_sunken_court
schemes.secondary_language: three barrel bays over a court dropped below grade
schemes.formal_principle: 세 개의 볼트가 지반 아래로 내려앉은 마당을 덮는다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: a vaulted roof and a sunken room
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; a basement band is outside the floor-area ratio while building area counts the above-grade projection only

ops.why: a rounded-end plan at half the height budget; the plan family is part of the opening and a matrix cannot produce it later
the section is a base shape: three barrels sampled as a curve rather than stepped, which is what lets the hall read as one room
the court goes below grade so the vault clears it; the delivered basement band is outside the floor-area ratio and the limitation is that the whole body sinks rather than the court alone

schemes.name: comp18_hexagonal_cluster_locked_by_one
schemes.secondary_language: a hexagonal-plan cluster with one member driven into its neighbour
schemes.formal_principle: 육각 평면의 무리 가운데 하나가 이웃을 파고들어 전체를 붙든다.

ops.why: four unequal hexagonal objects on a tying plate; the opening already halved the height so the cluster is low and wide rather than a set of towers
one member is driven into its neighbour so the cluster is locked rather than merely adjacent, and the host pays for the overhang out of its own body
the shared room is cut through the cluster from the street side

schemes.name: comp18_folded_plate_reads_as_one_surface
schemes.secondary_language: a concertina roof over a bar a quarter of the plot depth
schemes.formal_principle: 접힌 판 하나가 지붕과 벽을 한 면으로 잇는다.

ops.why: a quarter of the plot depth at the full budget, on a splayed plan that the fold will run across
the section keeps its breaks rather than sampling them away - a concertina is a vault that admits it has corners
the folded plate is raised so the ground runs under it; the columns are structure rather than floor area and the enclosed volume above is unchanged

schemes.name: comp18_two_bars_crossing_at_mid_height
schemes.secondary_language: two bars at right angles passing through one another above the ground
schemes.formal_principle: 두 개의 바가 공중에서 서로를 관통하며 아래를 열어 둔다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: a crossing held in the air

ops.why: a quarter of the plot length at the full budget - a bar slender enough that a second can cross it
the second bar is the first turned across the plot; a reflection preserves volume exactly, so the pair costs what one bar costs twice and nothing more
the crossing is held clear of the ground so the plot runs under both bars; the columns are structure rather than floor area

schemes.name: comp18_mansard_wall_along_the_street
schemes.secondary_language: a narrow street wall with steep shoulders and a flat crown, said twice across a court
schemes.formal_principle: 가로를 따라 선 좁은 벽이 가파른 어깨와 평평한 정수리를 갖고, 그것이 마당을 사이에 두고 두 번 선다.
schemes.dominant_gesture: two street walls holding a court
schemes.reference_basis: original authorship; the mansard drop is capped at one and a half storeys and its shoulder run is derived from the declared pitch

ops.why: an eighth of the plot depth at the full budget - the narrow standing wall the mansard belongs to
steep shoulders and a flat crown; on a narrow deep-set body this is a street wall rather than the tent it becomes on a wide low one
the wall is said twice across the plot so the space between them is a court held by two fronts rather than one wall and a leftover
